workflows.name: MCAC to CRUD Policy
workflows.summary: Translate View, Operate, Manage, and Admin levels into feature-level CRUD access.

steps.title: View
steps.description: Allow read-only access to permitted module features within the user's scope.

steps.title: Operate
steps.description: Allow day-to-day create, read, and update operations; approval and destructive actions stay blocked.

steps.title: Manage
steps.description: Allow create, read, update, moderation, approvals, corrections, and operational control without module configuration.

steps.title: Admin
steps.description: Allow full feature administration including configuration and delete where audit policy permits it.

workflows.name: Scope Resolution
workflows.summary: Apply Self, Department, Institution, or Cross-Institution scope after role and CRUD permissions are resolved.

steps.title: Self Scope
steps.description: Students, parents, and personal staff views can access only their own or linked records.

steps.title: Department Scope
steps.description: HODs, faculty, exam cell, and department coordinators operate only inside their department.

steps.title: Institution Scope
steps.description: Principal, registrar, finance, and admin staff operate across one college.

steps.title: Cross-Institution Scope
steps.description: Management views and controls permitted features across the tenant group.

workflows.name: Sensitive Module Rules
workflows.summary: Apply explicit restrictions for Fees, Examination, Attendance, Gate Pass, and No Due workflows.

steps.title: Fees & Finance
steps.description: Only Finance and Management receive Admin; students and parents can view own ledger and operate payments.

steps.title: Examination
steps.description: Exam Controller receives Admin; faculty can enter marks only for assigned subjects; students read published results.

steps.title: Attendance
steps.description: Faculty mark class attendance, students view their own attendance, and HODs manage corrections and reports.

steps.title: Gate Pass
steps.description: Students request gate passes, wardens approve, and security verifies at the gate.

steps.title: No Due
steps.description: Finance, Hostel, and Library clearance must be approved before certificate generation.

workflows.name: Cross-Module Handoffs
workflows.summary: Gate critical ERP handoffs through the required module and CRUD permissions.

steps.title: Student Onboarding to Academic Management
steps.description: Registrar Admin permission activates the student into academic records.

steps.title: CRM ERP Handoff to Student Onboarding
steps.description: Finance confirms payment, then Registrar triggers onboarding.

steps.title: Fees & Finance to No Due
steps.description: Finance clearance is required before No Due certificate generation.

steps.title: Examination to Placement
steps.description: Exam Controller publishes results and Placement uses CGPA for eligibility.
